Testimonials.heading: What Our Customers Say
Testimonials.subtitle: Hear from travelers who've experienced Hawya's car rental service across Saudi Arabia

list.name: Ahmed Al-Sulaiman
list.content: Hawya made my business trips across Saudi so convenient. The cars are always clean and well-maintained. Their service in Dammam is exceptional!

list.name: Sarah Al-Ghamdi
list.content: We rented an SUV for our family trip from Khobar to Riyadh. The process was smooth and the child seats were perfectly installed. Highly recommend!

list.name: Mohammed Al-Harbi
list.content: As an expat working in Jubail, I rely on Hawya for my monthly car rentals. Their prices are fair and their staff speaks excellent English.

list.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
list.content: I was nervous about renting a car for the first time, but Hawya staff in Dhahran guided me through everything. The car was perfect for city driving.
